name: Beszel
author: henrygd

control._comment: Hub and agent move together, or the agent spams a hub that is not there. Stop the agent first, then the hub; start brings the hub up before the agent connects to it. `primary` points at the hub because that is the half with a URL.

description: Resource graphs for this box: CPU, RAM, GPU, disk usage and I/O, network and temperatures, with history and threshold alerts. Answers "why is it slow", where Uptime Kuma only answers "is it up". A hub container on 127.0.0.1:8092 plus a native agent on 127.0.0.1:45876 that reads /proc, hwmon and the docker socket.
